name: Fisheries and catch records
one_line: The operator-side evidence chain for one fishing vessel or fleet activity: an authorised vessel or quota, a voyage or fishing operation, effort and area evidence, species-level retained or discarded catch, landing or transhipment, and the reconciliation or compliance record that connects those observations. A species name, vessel identifier, landing port, quota word, map, sales note or government licence is not sufficient without the catch-operation relation. Placeholder template: the resource_operations schema remains field-less pending R1c.

deterministic: a fishing logbook or electronic catch record whose labelled or structured slots join a vessel registration or IMO-like identifier, trip or voyage reference, departure or return, fishing date, gear or effort, fishing area, species, retained/discarded status, quantity and unit

a landing declaration whose own form joins the originating vessel and trip or landing reference to landing port, landing date, species, presentation, landed weight, weighing status and declaration or submission state

a transhipment declaration or event report that joins donor and receiving vessel identifiers, a trip or event reference, position or port, date/time, species and quantities transferred, and acknowledgment or submission status

a quota or entitlement ledger whose rows join one vessel, licence, quota allocation or stock/area entitlement to catch or landing uptake, remaining balance, transfer or lease event, and reporting period; a quota table without vessel or catch linkage is not enough

a vessel-monitoring or activity extract that joins a fishing vessel to timed positions, departure/arrival, gear or fishing-event markers and an accepted logbook, catch or landing reference; a vessel track alone is movement evidence, not catch fact

an observer, electronic-monitoring or inspection report whose labelled trip and vessel identifiers join gear deployment, species composition, retained/discarded observations, samples or estimated catch, and an inspection or review outcome

a catch-to-landing reconciliation that compares logbook or electronic catch by species with landing, weighing, sales-note or transport quantities and records adjustments, discrepancy reasons, approval or enforcement follow-up

a catch certificate or traceability packet that joins a product lot or consignment to an originating fishing vessel, voyage, catch area, species, quantities and landing or first-sale evidence; a certificate number or product lot alone is insufficient

a farmed-fish or aquaculture harvest register only when it explicitly joins a production unit or licensed site to harvest event, species, quantity, lot and transfer/landing status; generic aquaculture husbandry is not this capture-fisheries row

an archive manifest exposing a bounded voyage or reporting packet containing logbook, landing, quota, VMS, observer and reconciliation members; the manifest is inspected without unpacking and does not copy one member's vessel, species or period facts to every member
needs_llm: whether an unlabelled species-and-weight spreadsheet is a vessel catch record, a fish-market sales ledger, an aquaculture harvest, a laboratory dataset, a public statistic or a logistics consignment when headings are weak
whether a vessel and port appearing in a document are the operating vessel and landing site, a regulator's case subject, a carrier, a cited example or a customer in a sales document
whether a quota or licence file is the operator's continuing entitlement, a government issuer-side administration case, a policy publication or a broker's transaction record
whether an AIS/VMS track is tied to fishing effort and catch or is a generic vessel-movement export, and whether a time interval is a fishing operation rather than transit or anchorage
whether an observer or electronic-monitoring report records actual retained/discarded catch, a sampling estimate, a scientific survey or an enforcement allegation; the model must preserve uncertainty
whether landing, sales-note and transport quantities reconcile to the same trip and species presentation, rather than copying a nearby vessel or consignment's facts

whether a catch certificate packet is operator evidence, a buyer/importer's traceability file, a customs case or a government verification record when identical submitted bytes are held by different parties
whether OCR-poor handwritten logbook pages preserve enough vessel, trip, date, area, gear, species and quantity structure to activate, with unknown returned when the join cannot be cited
whether a screenshot of an electronic logbook or quota portal is a fisheries record or a generic web image; OCR-visible roles may support review but missing EXIF is not screenshot proof
multilingual species, gear, landing and quota forms outside the local term and authority catalogues
never_alone: the words fish, fishing, fisheries, catch, landing, quota, vessel, skipper, trawl, net, gear, species, discard, transhipment, port or seafood alone
a species, FAO code, stock, commodity, weight, unit or market price alone; the value may be a research sample, invoice line, cargo, public statistic or food-production record
a vessel name, registration number, IMO-like number, call sign, MMSI, licence number, trip number or quota reference outside a labelled operating role
a port, coastline, ICES area, statistical rectangle, coordinate, chart or vessel track alone; these may be navigation, tourism, environmental, engineering or public-data evidence
a quota, licence, entitlement, catch certificate or compliance word or identifier alone; government, business administration and logistics retain the same records
a quantity, landing date, fishing date, interval timestamp, species table or weighing result alone
a sales note, invoice, transport document, consignment, product lot, buyer or auction reference alone; logistics and finance may own the commercial transaction
a source_type or extension alone, including PDF, CSV, XLSX, XML, JSON, image, OCR, email, calendar, archive or opaque binary
a parent folder named Fishing, Fishery, Catch, Boats, Quota, Seafood, Landing, Marine, Vessel or Compliance alone
membership in one download, upload, email thread, portal session or archive alone; 00 states: "A session should never be treated as proof of topic"
a camera photograph or screenshot with or without EXIF; absence of EXIF does not prove a screenshot and EXIF does not prove an operating catch record
a regulator, fisheries department, port authority, auction, buyer, vessel owner or processing company name alone; its role must be evidenced in the record structure

work_types: quota allocation, transfer or uptake ledger
inspection, infringement or corrective-action record tied to a trip
aquaculture harvest record where the licensed production relation is explicit
grouping_reasons: one vessel and voyage across departure, fishing activity, catch, VMS/AIS, return, landing and submission receipts
one species/stock and area entitlement across quota allocation, catch uptake, transfer, landing and reconciliation records
one landing or transhipment event across originating vessel, receiving vessel, declaration, weighing, transport and first-sale evidence
one catch discrepancy across logbook, landing declaration, observer or inspection record, correction and enforcement response
one traceability packet linking a landed product lot to its originating vessel, trip, area, species and quantities without treating buyer custody as operator fact
a sparse screenshot, email, calendar entry or image may join an accepted voyage or landing group without receiving vessel, trip, species, area or quantity facts; grouping does not copy labels

template.why: The template is field-less because PR-6 and D1 defer resource_operations fields to R1c. Conditional on that adjudication, this situation's useful projection is operating_site or landing_context -> vessel/asset -> voyage or reporting_period -> record_type, with species/stock and entitlement as searchable evidence or optional dimensions only where a corpus genuinely needs them. This differs from the schema's broad site -> operating_authority -> output_stream -> reporting_period -> record_type proposal: a catch record is intelligible through vessel-and-voyage context, while quota and species values usually repeat across records and create one-child branches. It is not time-first; 00 says: "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders." No executable dimension is claimed until R1c licenses a canonical key.

collides_with.signal: SAME FIXTURE BYTES: Fishing-Vessel-Licence-FV-2048.pdf. Fisheries wins only when the licence is joined in the operator's own voyage/catch packet to a vessel, activity, entitlement use or landing; government.permit-licensing wins when the same bytes are the issuer-side application, approval, renewal, condition or enforcement case, and neither side may infer a catch event from the licence alone.

SAME FIXTURE BYTES: Observer-Trip-07_Report.pdf. Fisheries wins when the report is retained as vessel-trip catch, effort, observer or discard evidence; government.environmental-regulation wins when the same bytes are a regulator's surveillance, protected-species, habitat or enforcement record, and fisheries must not turn a regulatory observation into a declared catch without the operating chain.

SAME FIXTURE BYTES: Quota-Uptake_Vessel-VS123_2026.xlsx. Fisheries wins when rows reconcile an operator's vessel/stock entitlement to catch or landing uptake; business_operations.corporate-regulatory-filings wins when the same bytes are a company's submitted statutory return or filing-control record, and neither side may use the workbook's existence to prove the other custody role.

SAME FIXTURE BYTES: Fishing-Vessel-Engine-Maintenance-Report.pdf. Fisheries wins only when the maintenance record is joined to an accepted vessel-trip or operating catch packet; engineering.drawing-package wins when the same vessel or gear bytes are controlled technical drawings, revisions or maintenance design evidence, and a vessel asset identifier alone never activates fisheries.

SAME FIXTURE BYTES: Fish-Transport-Document_Lot-L-771.pdf. Fisheries wins when the document is part of the originating voyage/landing/catch-certificate chain and its species and quantities are reconciled to the vessel operation; logistics.shipment wins when the same bytes govern post-landing custody, vehicle, seals, destination or consignment movement, and transported product weight is not silently rewritten as catch.

sensitivity_why: Vessel identifiers, crew or skipper names, precise fishing positions, quota balances, commercially sensitive catch and landing quantities, enforcement observations and account or submission credentials may identify people, reveal activity patterns or expose regulated/commercial operations. This row assigns no handling class; P7's file-level classification and local/cloud policy remain authoritative.
open_question: NJ-FISH-1: R1c must decide whether vessel, voyage/period, operating authority and catch/output roles can reuse the resource_operations proposals (site, operating_authority, asset, output_stream, reporting_period, record_type) or require one neutral global role. The fisheries projection wants vessel-and-voyage context, but a field-less placeholder cannot serialize it. NJ-FISH-2: Should an operator-held catch certificate that also supports a buyer/importer traceability group be coactivated through P9 only, or should a future logistics/finance template own a formal cross-schema relation? This row records the evidence and does not author also_holds_with. NJ-FISH-3: R2/R4 must settle how species codes, fishing areas and vessel identifiers are validated per deployment; no jurisdiction-specific regex or gazetteer is asserted here.
